summary: Ranger Energy Services (NYSE:RNGR) filed Form 8-K on April 27, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 results and a quarterly cash dividend of $0.06/share payable May 22, 2026 to holders of record May 8, 2026. Revenue was $159.1M, net income $3.0M ($0.12/diluted share). The dividend is a direct capital return to shareholders, declared by the Board with future dividends at the Board's discretion. This is a routine capital return event, not an ordinary operational 8-K, as it highlights a shareholder distribution. Watch for sustainability of dividend amid oilfield services cyclicality; no risk-arb angle as there is no M&A.
